label: Plate kinematics
text: EA.O.A2.1 Plate kinematics. The lithosphere is divided into plates that move relative to one another. Boundaries are divergent, convergent or transform. Evidence: continental fit, rock and fossil correlation, seafloor magnetic anomalies, seismicity, and geodetic motion. Euler-pole description of plate motion holds for rigid plates on a sphere.

warrant.warrant: W4, W2 (inversions with error), W6 (boundary comparison)
warrant.standard: Geodetic rates with uncertainty; tomography with resolution test
warrant.defeaters: Non-unique inversion; model dependence; sparse coverage
